name: What is the best way to clean and maintain ceramic floor tiles?

mainEntity.name: What is the best way to clean and maintain ceramic floor tiles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintaining ceramic floor tiles is relatively simple. Regular sweeping or vacuuming is recommended to remove loose dirt and debris. For cleaning, use a mild, pH-neutral cleaner mixed with water. Avoid harsh chemicals, abrasive cleaners, or steel wool pads, as these can damage the glaze or grout. Mop the floor, ensuring not to oversaturate it, and promptly wipe up any spills. For tough stains, a gentle scrubbing brush can be used on the grout lines. Consistent cleaning helps preserve their appearance and longevity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clean ceramic tiles by regular sweeping and mopping with a mild, pH-neutral cleaner. Avoid harsh chemicals and promptly wipe spills to maintain their appearance.
